L34: Ballot Drop Box Information
L35: 
L36: The drop off box is a safe and convenient way to return your Voted Absentee Ballots. Avoid Election Day lines and waiting on mail, use the drop off box today!
L37: Where: 345 Oak Hill  Ave., 44502  in the circle parking lot of the Board of Elections. Ohio Secretary of State Directive 2023-03, permits each Board of Elections to have only one (1) secure receptacle outside of the Board office, for the purpose of receiving Absentee Ballots.
L38: 
L39: When: A bi-partisan team collects all Voted Absentee Ballots from the drop box periodically throughout the business day.
L40: Who: Voted Absentee Ballots can only be returned to the drop off box by the voter or a family member, including: the spouse, the father, mother, father-in-law, mother-in-law, grandfather, grandmother, brother, or sister of the whole or half blood, or the son, daughter, adopting parent, adopted child, stepparent, stepchild, uncle, aunt, nephew, or niece of the voter. Additionally, we ask the person returning the ballot over the counter to sign the back of the return envelope.
L41: 
L42: Don’t forget!
L43:   * The deadline to register to vote for the November 3, 2026 General Election is Monday October 5 2026 at 9:00 P.M.
L44: 
L45:   *  The deadline to return your completed Vote-by-Mail Ballot Application is to have it in by Tuesday October 27th by 8:30 P.M.
L46:   * The deadline to return your voted ballot to the Board of Elections is by Tuesday November 3rd before 7:30 P.M.
L47: 
L48: HOW TO RETURN YOUR ABSENTEE BALLOT:
L49: Ohio law requires all absentee ballots to be received by 7:30 p.m. on Election Day under one of the following options:
L50: 
L51: • BY MAIL: Complete your ballot, insert it into the return envelope, and return it with affixed postage to your county board of elections as soon as possible to allow for postal delivery by 7:30 p.m. on Election Day.
L52: • IN PERSON TO A DROP BOX: Complete your ballot, insert it into the return envelope, and return it in person without postage to the drop box located at your county board of elections by 7:30 p.m. on Election Day.
L53: • IN PERSON AT THE BOARD OF ELECTIONS OFFICE: Complete your ballot, insert it into the return envelope, and return it in person without postage to your county board of elections office by 7:30 p.m. on Election Day. Only you or a near relative* may deliver your ballot. A voter who is disabled may select anyone to deliver their ballot, other than their employer or an officer in their union.
L54: The person delivering a ballot for either a family member or a voter with a disability MUST complete an attestation form at the county board of elections office (Form 12-P). For county boards of elections locations and hours, please visit VoteOhio.gov/Boards.
L55: ***If you are a member of the uniformed services or a voter outside of the United States, ballots must be received by the fourth day after the election. Sign your identification envelope by the close of polls on Election Day or return it in person by 7:30 p.m. on Election Day.
L56:
